2 | 
3 | CORE builds a parallel 3D Earth in which proposed infrastructure changes can be simulated and stress-tested before people authorize them. The first intended product is coordination of road and utility works. **Agents propose; a deterministic gateway evaluates; humans authorize. CORE applies nothing to real infrastructure.**
4 | 
5 | This repository currently contains a static prototype, not a calibrated digital twin or production approval system.

1 | # Existing architecture
2 | 
3 | Historical architecture through Phase 4; later layers: PHASE_9_ARCHITECTURE.md, PHASE_10_REPORT.md, PHASE_11_REPORT.md. Consolidation controls and remaining boundaries: SECURITY_BASELINE.md; authority/sequence: MASTER_ROADMAP.md. This document is not a current completeness claim.

6 | 
7 | CORE is a static two-page application with committed public-data snapshots. There is no backend, database, account system, worker pool, LLM service, telemetry pipeline, or infrastructure actuator.

# CORE — Creation Of Reborn Earth

CORE builds a parallel 3D Earth in which proposed infrastructure changes can be simulated and stress-tested before people authorize them. The first intended product is coordination of road and utility works. **Agents propose; a deterministic gateway evaluates; humans authorize. CORE applies nothing to real infrastructure.**

This repository currently contains a static prototype, not a calibrated digital twin or production approval system.

# Existing architecture

Historical architecture through Phase 4; later layers: PHASE_9_ARCHITECTURE.md, PHASE_10_REPORT.md, PHASE_11_REPORT.md. Consolidation controls and remaining boundaries: SECURITY_BASELINE.md; authority/sequence: MASTER_ROADMAP.md. This document is not a current completeness claim.

Current state: Phase 4 (model-assisted agents, evaluated learning, living City Intelligence) complete — see `PHASE_4_REPORT.md`, `PHASE_4_AUDIT.md` and `CITY_INTELLIGENCE_ARCHITECTURE.md`.

CORE is a static two-page application with committed public-data snapshots. There is no backend, database, account system, worker pool, LLM service, telemetry pipeline, or infrastructure actuator.

```mermaid
flowchart LR
  Providers[Map and font providers] --> Globe[index.html / MapLibre]
  World[src/sf-world.js procedural landmarks] --> Globe
  Snapshot[scripts/sf-snapshot.mjs + src/sf-data.js] --> Data[data/sf GeoJSON + manifest]
  Data --> View[src/sf-view.js pilot view and inspector]
  View --> Globe
  Data --> Coord[src/coord.js deterministic agents + coordination gateway]

# CORE — master roadmap consolidé

Statut : reconstruction documentaire, pas ratification rétroactive. Base auditée : `1f0adb4` ; Phases 10/11 livrées à `a25169c` / `088ebe4`. Directions FD01–FD08 approuvées le 2026-10-14 ; mission actuelle : **Phase 13, moteur scientifique et preuve de bout en bout**, après récupération et livraison du Workstream 12, sans ouverture publique ni phase cosmétique. Constitution V1 et directions actuelles : [FOUNDER_DECISIONS.md](FOUNDER_DECISIONS.md). Les décisions de conversation absentes du dépôt restent UNVERIFIED / FOUNDER CONFIRMATION REQUIRED.
